brief: Holds one HTTP response that a handler fills and the server renders to bytes; it does no socket work itself.
detail: Status, Header, Text, Html and Json compose it. Send buffers the body once and marks it sent; HttpBytes renders the HTTP/1.1 wire form with CRLF line endings and a Content-Length counted in bytes. Json uses a simple serializer in which a flat [ key, value, ... ] list is an object; see its warning for the shapes it gets wrong.
